svg.title: The same 1.5m, two different days
svg.desc: Two views from above of 1.5 metres of swell reaching a beach. On the left, a 6-second wind swell: short, broken crests close together from two directions, whitecaps, and messy white water; it breaks about 1.3 metres at a swimming beach. On the right, a 13-second groundswell: long, even lines well apart, bending to the sand, and one clean line of white water; it breaks about 1.7 metres.
svg.text: Choppy and crumbly, from two ways
